recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE PASTA
ingredients: For the Gluten Free Flour Blend
For the Gluten Free Pasta Dough
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a large sealable container. - 15 oz brown rice flour - 12 oz white rice flour - 6 oz potato starch - 3 oz tapioca starch - 1 tbsp Xanthan gum
Whisk to evenly distribute all of the ingredients.
Store at room temperature. - For the Gluten Free Flour Blend
Combine the ingredients in the bowl of a stand mixer. - 14 oz gluten free flour blend - 8 oz eggs - 1 tbsp kosher salt
Using a paddle attachment, mix the dough for 3-4 minutes until completely homogenous. - For the Gluten Free Pasta Dough
Working with ¼ of the dough at a time, roll and fold the dough over itself until it fits nicely into the pasta roller attachment. - For the Gluten Free Pasta Dough

Using the roller attachment, roll the dough out to the second thinnest setting, or your desired thickness. Make sure to dust the roller with more gluten-free flour. - For the Gluten Free Pasta Dough - For the Gluten Free Flour Blend

Using the pasta cutter of your choice, cut the pasta and fold it into nests. Place the nests on a rimmed baking sheet with a generous dusting of gluten-free flour. - For the Gluten Free Pasta Dough - For the Gluten Free Flour Blend
Cut the pasta to your desired size and/ or shape - For the Gluten Free Pasta Dough
